name: St. Gallen-Altenrhein Airport

runway.v: Runway 10/28, concrete; TORA 1,455 m, LDA 1,400 m (TODA 1,515 m)

hours.v: IFR: Mon–Fri (incl. holidays) 06:30–12:00 and 13:30–21:00; Sat 07:30–12:00 and 13:30–20:00; Sun 10:00–12:00 and 13:30–20:00 local. Closed New Year's Day, Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday and Christmas Day.

curfew.v: Closed outside the hours above, including a midday break 12:00–13:30 every day; extensions on request

customs.v: Customs airport with Schengen and non-Schengen immigration; international arrivals and direct departures allowed. Hours not stated.
customs.quote: international arrivals and direct departures to an international destination are allowed

notes: Read People's Airport opening-hours and customs pages (no edition date). Swiss AIP not opened. Hours shown are the IFR hours (VFR hours are shorter); Saturday and Sunday close at 20:00. Midday closure 12:00–13:30 matters for scheduling. Short runway (LDA 1,400 m) limits larger jets.
